First discussed here.

There appears to be this misprint, Agent of Gloom side, at the end of turn: "...If there are more cards under the safe house than drugs face-up, flip a face-down villain card face-up."  The original card reads: "flip a drug face-down." —opposite actions.

What's the official word on this? Misprint or alteration?

EDIT: Just wanted to add here: the card is also missing "face-down villain cards are indestructible."
